mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS resultId, r.session_id AS sessionId, r.source_text AS sourceText, r.translated_text AS translatedText, r.speaker_name AS speakerName FROM interpretation_result r LEFT JOIN interpretation_embedding e ON r.id = e.result_id AND e.embedding_profile = #{embeddingProfile} WHERE e.id IS NULL AND r.source_text IS NOT NULL AND r.source_text != '' LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS sourceId, s.session_id AS sessionId, s.meeting_summary AS sourceText, s.title AS sessionTitle, s.meeting_id AS meetingId FROM interpretation_session s LEFT JOIN interpretation_embedding e ON e.source_type = 'meeting_summary' AND e.ref_id = s.id AND e.embedding_profile = #{embeddingProfile} WHERE e.id IS NULL AND s.meeting_summary IS NOT NULL AND s.meeting_summary != '' AND COALESCE(s.deleted, 0) = 0 LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ss.id AS sourceId, ss.session_id AS sessionId, ss.summary AS sourceText, ss.speaker_name AS speakerName, ss.title AS sessionTitle FROM speaker_summary ss LEFT JOIN interpretation_embedding e ON e.source_type = 'speaker_summary' AND e.ref_id = ss.id AND e.embedding_profile = #{embeddingProfile} WHERE e.id IS NULL AND ss.summary IS NOT NULL AND ss.summary != '' LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.id AS sourceId, f.meeting_id AS meetingId, f.file_name AS sessionTitle, f.summary AS sourceText FROM pre_meeting_file_persistent f LEFT JOIN interpretation_embedding e ON e.source_type = 'file_summary' AND e.ref_id = f.id AND e.embedding_profile = #{embeddingProfile} WHERE e.id IS NULL AND f.summary IS NOT NULL AND f.summary != '' LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.id AS sourceId, f.meeting_id AS meetingId, f.file_name AS sessionTitle, f.file_content AS sourceText FROM pre_meeting_file_persistent f LEFT JOIN interpretation_embedding e ON e.source_type = 'file_content' AND e.ref_id = f.id AND e.embedding_profile = #{embeddingProfile} WHERE e.id IS NULL AND f.file_content IS NOT NULL AND f.file_content != '' LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ai.id AS sourceId, ai.session_id AS sessionId, ai.meeting_id AS meetingId, ai.content AS sourceText, ai.assignee AS speakerName FROM meeting_action_item ai LEFT JOIN interpretation_embedding e ON e.source_type = 'action_item' AND e.ref_id = ai.id AND e.embedding_profile = #{embeddingProfile} WHERE e.id IS NULL AND ai.content IS NOT NULL AND ai.content != '' LIMIT #{limit}
